surface-brand.$description: Alias. Brand fill: primary buttons, checked boxes, the selected day, a Switch that's on, a Progress bar, with `text-on-brand` (white) on it. Light themes: brand 600 or 700, the lightest with 4.5:1 for white text. Dark themes: the same shade, lightened as far as 3:1 on a raised dark card asks and always a touch, 0.02 of OKLCH lightness, while white text keeps 4.5:1 (blue-600 #2563eb becomes #2b6af2), so a button is the same color in both modes. Yellow is the exception: yellow 500 in light and yellow 400 in dark, under yellow-950 text, since a yellow dark enough for white text reads as brown; Yellow Light's fill takes a `border-brand`. Brand text, links, icons and lines are `text-brand`. More contrast: brand 800 with white text in light, brand 300 with brand-950 text in dark.

surface-brand-hover.$description: Alias. `surface-brand` under the pointer: one step darker, in light and dark themes alike (a dark theme's is lightened as much as its `surface-brand`). More contrast: brand 900 in light, brand 200 in dark.

surface-brand-pressed.$description: Alias. `surface-brand` held down: one step past `surface-brand-hover`, darker in light and dark themes alike, so a held primary button reads as held without a shrink. More contrast: one step past its more-contrast hover where the scale goes on.

surface-brand-subtle.$description: Alias. Brand tint for selected rows and badges (brand 50 light, brand 950 dark).

surface-brand-subtle-hover.$description: Alias. `surface-brand-subtle` under the pointer: one brand step past it (100 in light, 900 in dark).

surface-brand-subtle-pressed.$description: Alias. Pressed state of a fill in `surface-brand-subtle` (a secondary button held down): two brand steps past it (200 in light, 800 in dark; 900 in Red, Orange, Pink and Rose Dark, where 800 takes `text-brand-hover` under 4.5:1). `text-brand-hover` keeps 4.5:1 on it.

text-brand.$description: Alias. Brand text, links, icons, lines and borders: what `surface-brand` is as a fill, 4.5:1 as text on `surface`, `surface-sunken` and the tints. Light themes: the same shade as `surface-brand`; dark themes: brand 400, which a dark page needs for text. More contrast: brand 800 / brand 300, 7:1+ on `surface` and `surface-brand-subtle`.

text-brand-hover.$description: Alias. `text-brand` on hover: a link or a secondary button's text under the pointer. One step past `text-brand` (darker in light themes, lighter in dark).

focus-ring.$description: Alias. Keyboard focus outline, in the brand hue (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme). More contrast: brand 700 / brand 300.
